# CartGenerator 0.5.3 macOS Hotfix
Release date: 2026-10-07 Platform: macOS arm64 Distribution: ad-hoc-signed direct-download DMG (not notarized)
## Artifact
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.3-macOS-arm64.dmg` - Size: 256 MB - SHA-256: `12832ef68a6d982bcb024671d364682e1b5a42c3896baf3356b40c82c0ef6f22`
## Step 3 fixes
- Progress, result cards, filter counts, and table counts now use the actual number of included production requests instead of the 18-row preview fixture. - A 73-item job at 18 completed items now displays `18 / 73` and approximately 24.7%, rather than filling the progress bar. - Result-table vertical and horizontal scroll positions are retained when the next item result refreshes the Step 3 UI. - Starting a new run still resets the result table to the top. - The unexported-result warning remains as a data-loss safeguard for rerun and destructive navigation, but its native dialog now wraps and centers content without the oversized icon/text columns or clipped message.
## Verification performed
- 227 Python tests passed. - 6 Cloudflare Worker tests passed. - Python compilation and source diff checks passed. - Real Chromium local-HTML QA verified a 73-row production state, `18 / 73` progress, 24.7% result ratio, scroll retention across a result update, and scroll reset on a new run. - Confirmation-dialog rendering was verified at 430x133 pixels with wrapped, centered text and centered buttons. - No live cart mutation was performed for this UI hotfix.
## Installation
1. Use Help -> Check for Updates in CartGenerator 0.5.2, or download the DMG. 2. If using the DMG, drag `CartGenerator.app` to `Applications` and replace the previous version. 3. For the non-notarized direct build, Control-click the app and choose **Open** if macOS requests confirmation.
## Source archive
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.3-source.tar.gz` - SHA-256: `65cd40826a113873e1b11852e554591a5896c12dfb3e3b38eb3d0c269b0b7547`
The archive excludes Git internals, virtual environments, generated binaries, release artifacts, release-note metadata, diagnostics, local environment files, and caches.
## Automatic updates
The EdDSA-signed Sparkle feed and update ZIP are published from `52274b/CartGenerator-Releases`. After publication, CartGenerator 0.5.2 will be offered this 0.5.3 UI hotfix.
